task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"dsh-markdown-preview","id":"gh:1334835912","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-markdown-preview","slug":"GitHubJiKe/dsh-markdown-preview","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-markdown-preview"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-markdown-preview"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**In-chat preview for produced files in DeepSeek Harness Web.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"By default, clicking a produced-file chip in the DSH Web GUI hands the file to the operating system'"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s default application (`open` on macOS → Xcode for many extensions). This plugin makes that click **"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"render the file right in the conversation** — Markdown is rendered with `markdown-it` + `highlight.j"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"s` server-side, images preview inline, **code files (JSON / JS / TS / Python / YAML / …) open in a d"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ark syntax-highlighted code view**, and any other text file shows as plain text. The stock behaviors"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" stay one click away: open in the system app, or reveal in the folder."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Click a produced-file chip → inline preview**, no native app, no new tab. - **Markdown rendered "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"properly** (GFM tables, fenced code, blockquotes, links, hard line breaks) with **syntax highlightin"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"g** in code fences (highlight.js common languages). - **Code-file preview with full syntax highlight"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ing** (v0.3.0): 40+ extensions (`.json` `.js` `.ts` `.py` `.yml` `.sh` `.css` `.html` …) render in a"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" dark editor-style view with GitHub-Dark token colors, highlighted server-side. - **Fullscreen viewe"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"r** (v0.3.0): one click expands the preview — Markdown, image, code, or plain text — to a full-viewp"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ort overlay with the toolbar kept on top; close with the button or `Esc`. - **Image preview** (PNG /"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" JPEG / GIF / WebP / SVG) as data URLs — no extra route. SVG is safe to inline: browsers never execu"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"te scripts inside SVG loaded through an `` element. - Plain-text fallback for every other text "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"file; binary files are sniffed and refused with a clear message. - Panel header with file size, **fu"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"llscreen**, **copy content**, **open in system app**, and collapse. - 1 MiB cap for text / 4 MiB for"},{"id":"p6s12","text":" images, with an explicit truncation notice. - Keeps the stock experience: chips, "+ N files", and ""},{"id":"p6s13","text":"Show in folder" still behave as before, and inline code-mentions of produced files stay clickable. -"},{"id":"p6s14","text":" **Theme-aware preview panel**: background, body text, links, code and error colors all use real DSH"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" theme variables (v0.1.1 fixes unreadable text on the always-white background in dark mode)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin is **purely additive**. Its Bundle Patch inserts one plugin-owned row and disables, rena"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"mes, and re-declares nothing: every official component keeps its own registration and its own entry "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ID. In particular the official produced-files bundle stays enabled — this plugin does not take over "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"its `deliverables` Conversation Node definition, its `chatFileMentions` provider, its `deliverables`"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" locale namespace, or its host-side file-reference prompt section."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **One slot entry, won by priority.** The produced-files row lives on the `conversation.chat.turnTa"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"il` **chain** seat. A chain seat elects the first entry whose selector accepts, in ascending slot pr"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"iority, which is the slot layer's documented extension point ("register at a different priority to s"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"hadow it"). The client half registers there at priority `-1`: the smallest step that beats the offic"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ial fallback (priority `0`) while leaving every contributor below it room to shadow this row — a spe"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"cialised produced-HTML row at `-10`, for instance, keeps the HTML turns it selects for. The official"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" row stays registered and renders as before for every turn this plugin declines, and whenever this p"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"lugin is uninstalled. - **The file list is read, not recomputed.** The selector reads the `deliverab"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"les` Turn data that the official row already publishes. Turns that also declare *presented* files de"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"liberately decline here, so the official row keeps the surface and host routes that own them. This p"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"lugin therefore expects the official produced-files row to stay enabled — it ships in the `dsh-web-a"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"pp` bundle, and if another layer disables it there is no published produced-file list left to previe"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"w. - **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): serves `read` (file content — Markdown rendered to **escaped HT"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ML** with `markdown-it` `html:false` and its [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Compatibility and verification"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`package.json` declares an exact `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` matrix. Every `compatible` entry be"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"low was verified by **installing this plugin into a disposable DSH profile and booting it on an isol"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ated port**, then driving the plugin's own preview surface over HTTP and confirming that the officia"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"l produced-files surface was still mounted:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| DSH release | Compatibility | Install / start / uninstall | Route carrier observed |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `0.1.1-rc.2` | compatible | passed | logical `/preview` channel | | `0.1.5-rc.2` | compatible | pa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ssed | exact `/api/markdown-preview.*` routes | | `0.1.6-alpha.1` | unknown | unknown | not run (see"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" note) | | `0.1.6-alpha.2` | compatible | passed | exact `/api/markdown-preview.*` routes |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Each run checked: the web service starts with no plugin error and no duplicate registration; `POST` "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"on the plugin's `capabilities` and `read` endpoints answers with the expected result; a Markdown fil"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"e comes back rendered with server-side `highlight.js`; the official produced-files client is still p"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"resent in the served boot manifest and its bundle still returns `200`; this plugin's client bundle i"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"s registered in the boot manifest and served; and the service shuts down cleanly. `test/mock-test.mj"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"s` covers the same contract offline for both carriers (68 assertions)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> `0.1.6-alpha.1` is declared `unknown` rather than `compatible` because that > release cannot be bo"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"oted cleanly from npm: its caret dependency ranges resolve > to `0.1.6-alpha.2` internals, and `@dee"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"pseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` dropped an export > that `0.1.6-alpha.1` still imports. The package surfaces "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"this plugin depends on > were checked statically on that release and match `0.1.6-alpha.2`, but no c"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"lean > install/start/uninstall run was possible, so no run evidence is claimed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Releases outside the table (for example `0.1.2-alpha.*`, `0.1.3-alpha.*`, `0.1.5-alpha.*`, `0.1.5-rc"},{"id":"p16s2","text":".1`) are undeclared, which the registry records as `unknown`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The preview surface sits behind the connection trust fence on both carriers: the `/preview` channe"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"l is registered `loopback`-only, and the `/api` exact routes inherit the shared channel's Host/Origi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"n fence plus browser authentication. - Markdown is rendered with `html:false`; raw HTML in a documen"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"t is escaped, and links are limited to `http(s)/mailto/#` by `markdown-it`'s default `validateLink`."},{"id":"p18s5","text":" - Preview caps and binary sniffing prevent accidental memory/UI abuse; the preview is read-only (no"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" write endpoint). - `open` only ever hands a path to the deployment's own native desktop opener; it "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"never executes the file. `capabilities` is consulted first, so the action is hidden on deployments w"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ithout a native desktop."}],"truncated":true}
